key_impacts: In Dakshin Bedkashi Union, 33 people were killed.
3,520 houses were washed away in Dakshin Bedkashi Union.
1,800 houses were partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi Union.
Coastal embankment was overtopped; six breaches occurred and 20.55 km of embankment (of 27.37 km) was damaged in the area.
Villages were inundated twice daily by tidal water until coastal polder rehabilitation in 2013, delaying recovery.
